title: vellumstone 制革厂赞助位置
instruction:
您是 Vellumstone Press 的高级编辑，正在为出版商 Milena Bonneau 准备周四与该书最大的广告商 Tanneryside Bureau 举行的赞助会议。 Tanneryside 希望为£240,000 资助一份长达 12 页的谷物处理增刊，并希望在出版前看到副本，并能够提取任何命名竞争设备的项目。该补充剂的直接生产成本为£72,000。定制数据削减会增加£6,000成本，而在同一期提供半页答辩权会取代其他广告的£10,000；徽标放置和预先瞄准没有单独可测量的成本。不要发明其他货币效应。 Tanneryside 的 Lars Hutchins 经常使用“预先看到”来表示批准，而我们的编辑团队则使用它来表示没有决策权的出版前可见性，因此该说明在确定之前不能依赖该术语。瓦莱里娅·法尔科纳 (Valeria Falconer) 也已经非正式地告诉拉斯，我们将确保 Tanneryside 在任何竞争对手的副本运行之前都“满意”，尽管没有做出任何书面承诺。坦纳里赛德预计会赢得胜利，并将反击：断然拒绝可能会结束交易，但一揽子同意会损害所有权并为以后的续约奠定底线。
准备`sponsorship_meeting_position.docx`，记录 Milena 在房间中可以使用的谈判位置，并准备`concession_register.xlsx`，为她提供可用让步、条件、边界和预计财务结果的操作记录。涵盖定制数据剪切、徽标放置、预先查看、同一问题答辩权、复制批准以及拟议的取消竞争对手报道的权利，而不建议 Vellumstone 是否应该接受整体赞助。应用截至 1 二月 2025 的英国出版和广告惯例。职位注释不超过四页，登记簿不超过一张工作表，优惠行不超过十二行。文件之间共享的图形、术语和顺序必须一致。使用这些文件名将这两个文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `sponsorship_meeting_position.docx` — 出版商赞助会议的简明谈判立场说明。 （最多四个渲染页面；必须说明运营边界，而不建议是否接受整体赞助；必须仅使用请求中提供的货币假设。）
- `concession_register.xlsx` — 可编辑的特许权顺序、条件、边界和预计财务结果登记册。 （一张工作表和不超过十二个让步行；计算、术语和顺序必须与位置说明一致。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

sheets.name: Concession register
rows: Tanneryside Bureau | Thursday meeting | Twelve-page supplement | UK practice at 1 Feb 2025
Agreed subject, population and period; aggregated/non-identifying output; methodology, limitations and data/interpretation distinction remain visible; no confidential source data.
Sponsorship furniture/designated promotional positions only; prominent “Sponsored supplement” or “Advertisement feature” disclosure; no implication of authorship of independent copy.

Named authorised recipients; two-business-day window; confidential/embargoed, version ID; no redistribution/public use; factual-error flags only; Vellumstone verifies and decides; no fresh approval round; one editorial contact.

Only for a material statement about Tanneryside/products; not competitor mention. Max half page, same issue, copy due by production deadline; Vellumstone may edit, fact-check, label or decline unfit copy.
No sponsor approval, required changes or publication delay.
No right to pull, suppress or veto coverage naming competing equipment. Apply relevance, evidence, accuracy and fair opportunity to address material criticism.
Commissioning, wording, headlines, images, prominence and publication remain editorial decisions; product claims require ordinary substantiation and review.
Sponsored material clearly and prominently labelled and visually/editorially distinct from independent coverage.
Genuine errors follow Vellumstone’s normal post-publication corrections or complaints route; no special removal right.
Commercial and editorial channels stay separate. Beyond-note requests escalate to Milena before agreement; concessions provisional until written confirmation; issue-specific and non-precedent.
Scenario check (formula-derived; projected, not guaranteed profit)
Logo placement / advance sight: no separately measurable monetary effect supplied.
Internal working record • update only by written confirmation

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
VELLUMSTONE PRESS  |  INTERNAL POSITION NOTE
Tanneryside Bureau sponsorship meeting
Thursday • Publisher: Milena Bonneau • Twelve-page grain-handling supplement
Purpose
Practice frame
Commercial baseline
Use in room
Record the permitted negotiating position; it is not a recommendation to accept or reject the sponsorship.
UK publication and advertising practice as at 1 February 2025.
£240,000 sponsorship revenue; £72,000 direct production cost; projected baseline contribution £168,000.
Offer in sequence; pause and escalate any request outside the boundaries below.

Room position
Opening line: “We can discuss a clearly labelled sponsored supplement and a graduated set of practical access and response rights. Editorial decisions remain with Vellumstone.”
Relationship context: Valeria Falconer told Lars Hutchins informally that we would make Tanneryside “comfortable with” competitor copy. No written commitment was made. Acknowledge the intent to engage, but state that it did not create copy approval or a competitor veto and cannot displace our standards.
Concession ladder (offer only in this order)
Stage
Permitted offer and guardrails
1  Bespoke data cut
Offer first. A bounded subject, population and period agreed in the brief; aggregated/non-identifying output only. Methodology and limitations stay visible, and data is distinguished from Tanneryside interpretation. Incremental cost: £6,000. Projected contribution: £162,000.
2  Logo placement
Designated sponsorship furniture or promotional positions only, with a prominent “Sponsored supplement”/“Advertisement feature” disclosure. The logo must not imply authorship or endorsement of independent copy. No separately measurable monetary effect supplied.
3  Advance sight (visibility, not approval)
Define the term before using it: pre-publication visibility for named, authorised Tanneryside recipients during a two-business-day review window. It confers no approval, veto, withdrawal or publication-decision right. Comments are limited to possible factual errors; Vellumstone verifies independently and decides any correction. PDF marked “Advance sight – version [ID] – confidential/embargoed”; no redistribution or public use. Later editorial changes do not trigger a fresh approval round. One Vellumstone editorial contact receives comments; no direct routing to writers, designers or production.
4  Same-issue right of reply
Fallback only after the first three stages. Triggered by a material statement about Tanneryside or its products—not by a competitor mention or favourable treatment. Maximum half a page in the same issue; copy due by the production deadline. Vellumstone may edit, fact-check, label or decline material that is inaccurate, unlawful, over-promotional or otherwise unfit. Displaced advertising effect: £10,000. Projected contribution: £158,000; with data cut: £152,000.
Non-negotiables and operating controls
Copy approval is outside our negotiable authority. Tanneryside may not approve, require changes to, or delay copy.
A right to pull, suppress or veto coverage because it names competing equipment is outside our negotiable authority. Competitor coverage is governed by relevance, evidence, accuracy and fair opportunity to address material criticism—not sponsor preference.
Final control stays with Vellumstone’s editorial team: commissioning, wording, headlines, images, prominence and publication. Product-performance claims need ordinary substantiation and editorial review; sponsorship does not allow insertion, removal or alteration on demand.
Keep sponsored material visually and editorially distinct from independent coverage, with a prominent, readily understood disclosure on the supplement and any sponsorship furniture.
Commercial negotiation sits with the publisher/commercial channel; editorial decisions sit with the editorial lead. Escalate any request beyond this note to Milena Bonneau before agreeing it. Meeting concessions are provisional until recorded in writing.
Any agreed concession is for this supplement/issue only, creates no automatic renewal or other-title precedent, and does not replace Vellumstone’s ordinary post-publication corrections or complaints process.
If pressed for approval or competitor removal
Use: “That request exceeds the available position. We can offer bounded factual review and, where the trigger is met, a half-page same-issue reply under editorial control. Approval or competitor-based removal cannot be agreed as framed; I will escalate any revised proposal to Milena before commitment.”
Financial note: contributions above are projections under the stated assumptions (sponsorship revenue less direct production cost and only the supplied incremental effects); they are not guaranteed profit, cash or a complete publishing margin.

criteria.description: 两个必需的可交付成果都存在于顶层，位于确切请求的文件名下，并且是有效、可读的 Office 文件。
criteria.evidence: 工作目录文件列表和两个文件的成功解析。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认确切的名称sponsorship_meeting_position.docx和concession_register.xlsx，然后打开或解析每个文件。

original.criterion: Both required deliverables exist at the top level under the exact requested filenames and are valid, readable Office files.
original.evidence: Working-directory file listing and successful parsing of both files.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact names sponsorship_meeting_position.docx and concession_register.xlsx, then open or parse each file.

criteria.description: 渲染的位置注释不超过四页。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的 DOCX 页数。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准 Office 渲染器渲染 DOCX 并计算所有页面，包括大部分空白的尾页。

original.criterion: The rendered position note is no more than four pages.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX using a standard office renderer and count all pages, including mostly blank trailing pages.

criteria.description: 该工作簿仅包含一张可见的工作表和不超过十二行的实质性让步。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿结构和填充行检查。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算优惠行时忽略标题行；隐藏的工作表仍然违反单工作表约束。

original.criterion: The workbook contains exactly one visible working worksheet and no more than twelve substantive concession rows.
original.evidence: Workbook structure and populated row inspection.
original.grader_hint: Ignore a header row when counting concession rows; hidden worksheets still violate the one-worksheet constraint.

criteria.description: 该说明指出了周四举行的 Tanneryside 赞助会议，Milena Bonneau 是会议用户，以及拟议的 12 页补充材料。
criteria.evidence: 立场注释开头或上下文陈述。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受等效的简洁措辞，但所有三个上下文事实都必须存在。

original.criterion: The note identifies Thursday’s Tanneryside sponsorship meeting, Milena Bonneau as the meeting user, and the proposed twelve-page supplement.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent concise wording, but all three contextual facts must be present.

criteria.description: 该说明指出，截至1二月2025，其实践和合规框架是英国。
criteria.evidence: 注释中的范围、基础或状态措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找管辖权和日期，而不仅仅是对现行规则的一般参考。

original.criterion: The note states that its practice and compliance frame is the UK as at 1 February 2025.
original.evidence: Scope, basis or status wording in the note.
original.grader_hint: Look for both the jurisdiction and date, not merely a generic reference to current rules.

criteria.description: 该说明记录了运营谈判立场，而不是建议 Vellumstone 是否应该接受或拒绝整体赞助。
criteria.evidence: 说明的目的、结论和总体框架。
criteria.grader_hint: 当文件为 Milena 提供了明确的提议和限制但未变成接受/拒绝建议时授予。

original.criterion: The note records an operational negotiating position rather than recommending whether Vellumstone should accept or reject the sponsorship overall.
original.evidence: Purpose, conclusion and overall framing of the note.
original.grader_hint: Award when the document equips Milena with defined offers and limits but does not turn into an accept/reject recommendation.

criteria.description: 在使用该短语之前，该说明将“预先查看”定义为出版前的可见性，不授予批准、否决、撤回或出版决定权。
criteria.evidence: 定义或预先规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 定义必须解决两个相互竞争的解读，而不是仅仅重复这个短语。

original.criterion: Before relying on the phrase, the note defines “advance sight” as pre-publication visibility that does not confer approval, veto, withdrawal or publication-decision rights.
original.grader_hint: The definition must resolve the two competing readings rather than merely repeat the phrase.

criteria.description: 该说明将事实错误通知与编辑批准区分开来，并且仅在编辑验证后才允许更正。
criteria.evidence: 提前审查或更正语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找这两个要素：赞助商可能会标记事实错误，Vellumstone 独立验证并决定任何更改。

original.criterion: The note distinguishes factual-error notification from editorial approval and permits corrections only after editorial verification.
original.grader_hint: Look for both elements: the sponsor may flag factual errors, and Vellumstone independently verifies and decides any change.

criteria.description: 该职位明确保留 Vellumstone 编辑团队对委托、措辞、标题、图像、显着性和出版的最终控制权。
criteria.evidence: 编辑控制规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果清楚地涵盖内容和演示决策，则等效的分组语言是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The position expressly retains final control over commissioning, wording, headlines, images, prominence and publication with Vellumstone’s editorial team.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent grouped language is acceptable if it clearly covers content and presentation decisions.

criteria.description: 复制批准被认为是在可转让权限之外，而不是作为一种让步提供。
criteria.evidence: 任一工件中的红线或不可协商的规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 该职位必须明确保留批准权；关于保持独立性的模糊语言是不够的。

original.criterion: Copy approval is identified as outside the negotiable authority rather than being offered as a concession.
original.evidence: Red-line or non-negotiable provision in either artifact.
original.grader_hint: The position must clearly withhold approval rights; vague language about preserving independence is insufficient.

criteria.description: 由于提及竞争设备而提议的撤回、压制或否决覆盖范围的权利被确定为在可协商权限之外。
criteria.evidence: 红线或竞争对手覆盖规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件必须解决基于竞争对手的特定杀戮权，而不仅仅是通用否决权。

original.criterion: The proposed right to pull, suppress or veto coverage because it names competing equipment is identified as outside the negotiable authority.
original.grader_hint: The document must address the specific competitor-based kill right, not only a generic veto.

criteria.description: 非正式的“满意”承诺被准确地视为关系背景，而该立场则澄清它不会产生复制批准或竞争对手否决。
criteria.evidence: 瓦莱里娅·福尔科纳声明的背景、谈话要点或处理方式。
criteria.grader_hint: 当注释避免忽视承诺并将其夸大为具有约束力的编辑承诺时授予奖项。

original.criterion: The informal “comfortable with” promise is acknowledged accurately as relationship context, while the position clarifies that it did not create copy approval or a competitor veto.
original.evidence: Background, talking point or treatment of Valeria Falconer’s statement.
original.grader_hint: Award when the note avoids both ignoring the promise and overstating it as a binding editorial commitment.

criteria.description: 让步顺序从定制数据剪切开始，然后再进行涉及编辑副本的出现或处理的任何让步。
criteria.evidence: 寄存器中注释和序列字段中的有序位置。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查主题出现的明确顺序，而不是偶然的顺序。

original.criterion: The concession sequence begins with the bespoke data cut before any concession involving the appearance or handling of editorial copy.
original.evidence: Ordered position in the note and sequence field in the register.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the explicit order, not the accidental order in which topics happen to appear.

criteria.description: 徽标放置在定制数据切割之后，并在特许权序列中先于预视。
criteria.evidence: 在两个可交付成果中订购了特许权阶梯。
criteria.grader_hint: 两种关系都必须成立：数据切割在标识之前，标识在预视之前。

original.criterion: Logo placement follows the bespoke data cut and precedes advance sight in the concession sequence.
original.evidence: Ordered concession ladder in both deliverables.
original.grader_hint: Both relationships must hold: data cut before logo, and logo before advance sight.

criteria.description: 在特许权顺序中，未经批准的预付款先于同一问题的答辩权。
criteria.evidence: 在两个可交付成果中订购了特许权阶梯。
criteria.grader_hint: 超前瞄准阶段必须具有不批准资格。

original.criterion: Advance sight without approval precedes the same-issue right of reply in the concession sequence.
original.evidence: Ordered concession ladder in both deliverables.
original.grader_hint: The advance-sight stage must carry the no-approval qualification.

criteria.description: 复制批准和基于竞争对手的杀权保留在报价阶梯之外，并且不代表后续的让步。
criteria.evidence: 注释和寄存器中的顺序和状态处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 他们可能会显示为红线或请求的权利，但不得接收要约序列号。

original.criterion: Copy approval and the competitor-based kill right are kept outside the offer ladder and are not represented as later concessions.
original.evidence: Sequence and status treatment in the note and register.
original.grader_hint: They may appear as red lines or requested rights, but must not receive offer sequence numbers.

criteria.description: 定制的数据切割服务定义了有界的主题、人群或时期，而不是承诺无限制的分析。
criteria.evidence: 数据削减优惠的附加条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受任何实际的有限范围；不需要特定发明的数据集。

original.criterion: The bespoke data-cut offer defines a bounded subject, population or period rather than promising unrestricted analysis.
original.evidence: Conditions attached to the data-cut concession.
original.grader_hint: Accept any practical bounded scope; no particular invented dataset is required.

criteria.description: 数据削减条款规定，方法、限制以及数据和申办者解释之间的区别仍然可见。
criteria.evidence: 数据剪切条件或编辑使用警告。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找透明的方法论背景并防止赞助商主导的重新解释。

original.criterion: The data-cut provision states that methodology, limitations and the distinction between data and sponsor interpretation remain visible.
original.grader_hint: Look for transparent methodological context and protection against sponsor-led reinterpretation.

criteria.description: 数据剪切条款将输出限制为适当聚合或非识别信息，并且不承诺披露机密源数据。
criteria.evidence: 数据处理或保密条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 同等的隐私保护语言值得赞扬。

original.criterion: The data-cut provision limits output to suitably aggregated or non-identifying information and does not promise disclosure of confidential source data.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent privacy-preserving language earns credit.

criteria.description: 徽标的放置仅限于明确标识的赞助家具或指定的促销位置，并且不允许暗示独立副本的作者。
criteria.evidence: 徽标放置条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 边界必须说明位置以及与编辑作者身份的误导性关联。

original.criterion: Logo placement is confined to clearly identified sponsorship furniture or designated promotional positions and is not allowed to imply authorship of independent copy.
original.grader_hint: The boundary must address both location and misleading association with editorial authorship.

criteria.description: 该增刊必须包含显着的、易于理解的赞助或广告披露信息。
criteria.evidence: 标签或透明度规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 当措辞明确且突出时，接受赞助补充品、广告专题或社论式广告等标签。

original.criterion: The supplement is required to carry a prominent, readily understood sponsorship or advertising disclosure.
original.grader_hint: Accept labels such as sponsored supplement, advertisement feature or advertorial when the wording is unambiguous and prominent.

criteria.description: 该职位在赞助材料和普通独立报道之间保留了清晰的视觉和编辑区别。
criteria.evidence: 设计、标签和展示保障措施一起考虑。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估一个理性的读者是否不太可能将赞助商控制的促销误认为是普通的社论报道。

original.criterion: The position preserves a clear visual and editorial distinction between sponsored material and ordinary independent coverage.
original.evidence: Design, labelling and presentation safeguards considered together.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether a reasonable reader would be unlikely to mistake sponsor-controlled promotion for ordinary editorial coverage.

criteria.description: 高级副本访问仅限于指定审阅窗口内指定或授权的 Tanneryside 收件人。
criteria.evidence: 预视操作条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 具体持续时间可由作者选择；如果指定了获奖者类别和具体截止日期或窗口，则授予奖励。

original.criterion: Advance-copy access is limited to named or authorised Tanneryside recipients for a defined review window.
original.grader_hint: A specific duration may be chosen by the author; award if the recipient class and a concrete deadline or window are stated.

criteria.description: 预发副本被视为机密或禁运，在出版前不得重新分发或公开使用。
criteria.evidence: 预先瞄准的保密条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对继续流通或过早使用的有意义的限制。

original.criterion: Advance copies are treated as confidential or embargoed and cannot be redistributed or used publicly before publication.
original.grader_hint: Look for a meaningful restriction on onward circulation or premature use.

criteria.description: 预先查看流程会识别已审核的版本，并明确后续的编辑更改不会创建新的审批轮次。
criteria.evidence: 版本控制或复制冻结语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 授予实用版本标识符、水印或同等控制以及重复审查结束的奖项。

original.criterion: The advance-sight process identifies the reviewed version and makes clear that later editorial changes do not create a fresh approval round.
original.grader_hint: Award for a practical version identifier, watermark or equivalent control plus closure of repeated review.

criteria.description: 赞助商的评论将通过一位确定的 Vellumstone 编辑联系人转达，而不是直接转达给作家、设计师或制作人员。
criteria.evidence: 通讯渠道的提供。
criteria.grader_hint: 一个角色就足够了；不需要发明人。

original.criterion: Sponsor comments are routed through one identified Vellumstone editorial contact rather than directly to writers, designers or production staff.
original.grader_hint: A role is sufficient; no invented person is required.

criteria.description: 答辩权是由有关 Tanneryside 或其产品的重要声明触发的，而不是仅仅由竞争对手的提及或优惠待遇触发。
criteria.evidence: 答辩权资格条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 触发因素必须小于对竞争对手报道的普遍不满。

original.criterion: The right of reply is triggered by a material statement about Tanneryside or its products, not by the mere mention or favourable treatment of a competitor.
original.grader_hint: The trigger must be narrower than general dissatisfaction with competitor coverage.

criteria.description: 答辩权明确针对同一问题，并包括与生产兼容的提交截止日期。
criteria.evidence: 答复权计时规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当同一问题的放置和操作截止日期都明确时才授予。

original.criterion: The right of reply is expressly for the same issue and includes a submission deadline compatible with production.
original.grader_hint: Award only if both same-issue placement and an operational deadline are clear.

criteria.description: 回复权优惠的上限为半页，并且不会扩展到额外赞助空间的一般权利。

original.criterion: The right-of-reply offer is capped at half a page and does not expand into a general entitlement to additional sponsored space.

criteria.description: Vellumstone 保留对不准确、非法、超出范围的促销或其他不适合发布的材料进行编辑、事实核查、标记或拒绝回复的权利。

spec.professional_context: Vellumstone Press is managing a commercially important supplement proposal whose requested sponsor controls conflict with ordinary editorial safeguards. The documents will be used by the publisher during a live negotiation and retained as the record of the permitted negotiating position.
difficulty_sources: Defining an ambiguous sponsor-facing term before using it operationally
Reconciling an informal commercial promise with editorial independence
Sequencing bounded concessions without turning approval or suppression rights into negotiable defaults
Maintaining numerical and semantic agreement between a prose note and an editable register

authoring_plan.mode_and_intent: Construct a normative internal position that records permitted negotiating conduct rather than recommending whether to accept the sponsorship. The professional challenge is to preserve editorial independence while leaving a commercially usable concession path.
authoring_plan.reference_material: No reference files are created. All arbitrary local facts needed for scoring, including filenames, parties, date, page count, financial assumptions and required topics, are carried in the request.
gold_relationships: The offer sequence is bespoke data cut, then bounded logo placement, then advance sight without approval, then a conditional same-issue right of reply.
Copy approval and any right to pull or suppress coverage because it names competitors are red lines outside the numbered offer sequence.
Advance sight means pre-publication visibility for bounded factual comments; it never means approval, veto, withdrawal authority or final publication control.
The informal promise to keep Tanneryside comfortable is acknowledged as relationship context but does not override editorial standards or create an approval right.
Baseline projected contribution is sponsorship revenue less direct production cost.
The data-cut scenario deducts the supplied incremental data cost from baseline contribution.
The right-of-reply scenario deducts the supplied displaced-advertising amount from baseline contribution.
The combined scenario deducts both supplied incremental effects.
Logo placement and advance sight have no separately measurable monetary effect because the request supplies none.
All financial outcomes are projections under limited assumptions, not guaranteed profit or a complete publishing P&L.
required_professional_content: Clear sponsored-content labelling and visible separation from independent editorial material.
Final editorial control over commissioning, wording, presentation and publication.
A bounded factual-correction channel that does not become approval.
Confidential, controlled and version-specific handling of advance copy.
A right-of-reply trigger tied to material statements about Tanneryside, with a half-page cap, same-issue timing, production deadline and editorial fitness review.
Competitor coverage governed by relevance, evidence, accuracy and fairness rather than sponsor preference.
A bounded data-cut scope with methodology and privacy safeguards.
Distinct commercial and editorial authority, escalation beyond mandate and written confirmation of any concession.
Issue-specific duration and explicit non-precedent treatment for renewals.
An in-room response for demands that exceed the position.
authoring_plan.workbook_behaviour: Create one editable worksheet with visible numeric assumptions and formula-derived scenario contributions. Each material topic receives a distinguishable row or entry with offer/request, order or red-line status, conditions, authority and financial effect. Keep the populated concession entries within the twelve-row cap.
authoring_plan.document_behaviour: Create a concise position note that can be scanned during a live meeting, defines the ambiguous term before operational use, records the promise without inflating it, and keeps factual position-setting distinct from an overall sponsorship recommendation.
authoring_plan.cross_deliverable_controls: Use identical monetary figures, scenario outcomes, concession order, status labels and meaning of advance sight in both files. The workbook should function as the structured control record for the prose position.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: A passing solution gives Milena a commercially graduated but editorially bounded position, uses the supplied assumptions exactly, makes the two files agree and remains usable without author clarification. A plausible-looking submission that offers approval, permits competitor suppression, leaves advance sight ambiguous, ignores the informal promise or invents financial effects should lose the associated credit.

deliverables.description: A concise negotiating position note for the publisher’s sponsorship meeting.
constraints: Maximum four rendered pages; must state operational boundaries without recommending whether to accept the sponsorship overall; must use only the monetary assumptions supplied in the request.

deliverables.description: An editable register of concession sequence, conditions, boundaries and projected financial outcomes.
constraints: One worksheet and no more than twelve concession rows; calculations, terminology and sequencing must agree with the position note.

original_instruction:
You are the senior editor at Vellumstone Press, preparing publisher Milena Bonneau for Thursday’s sponsorship meeting with Tanneryside Bureau, the title’s largest advertiser. Tanneryside wants to fund a twelve-page grain-handling supplement for £240,000 and expects to see copy before publication and to be able to pull any item naming competing equipment. The supplement’s direct production cost is £72,000. A bespoke data cut would add £6,000 of cost, while providing a half-page right of reply in the same issue would displace £10,000 of other advertising; logo placement and advance sight have no separately measurable cost. Do not invent other monetary effects. Lars Hutchins at Tanneryside routinely uses “advance sight” to mean approval, while our editorial team uses it to mean pre-publication visibility without decision rights, so the note cannot rely on that term until it is pinned down. Valeria Falconer has also already told Lars informally that we would make sure Tanneryside was “comfortable with” any competitor copy before it ran, although no written commitment was made. Tanneryside expects to win ground and will counter: a flat refusal is likely to end the deal, but a blanket yes would compromise the title and establish a floor for later renewals. Prepare `sponsorship_meeting_position.docx`, recording the negotiating position Milena can use in the room, and `concession_register.xlsx`, giving her an operational record of the available concessions, conditions, boundaries and projected financial outcomes. Cover the bespoke data cut, logo placement, advance sight, a same-issue right of reply, copy approval and the proposed right to pull competitor coverage without recommending whether Vellumstone should accept the sponsorship overall. Apply UK publication and advertising practice as at 1 February 2025. Keep the position note to no more than four pages and the register to one worksheet with no more than twelve concession rows. Shared figures, terminology and sequencing must agree between the files. Write both files into the top level of the working directory using exactly those filenames.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `sponsorship_meeting_position.docx` — A concise negotiating position note for the publisher’s sponsorship meeting. (Maximum four rendered pages; must state operational boundaries without recommending whether to accept the sponsorship overall; must use only the monetary assumptions supplied in the request.)
- `concession_register.xlsx` — An editable register of concession sequence, conditions, boundaries and projected financial outcomes. (One worksheet and no more than twelve concession rows; calculations, terminology and sequencing must agree with the position note.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
